text: Ink, scars, a little of both. Sit.
Every mark tells a story. What's yours going to say?
Hold still. Or don't. Gives it character.
Listen to that thunder. Nobody sane is at sea tonight.
Storm's right on top of us. Stay in the dry a while.
Every timber in the harbour's groaning. Ugly night.
Rain again. Good for the cisterns, bad for the soul.
You're dripping on my floor, by the way.
Night's when the cursed come walking. Keep a lantern lit.
Up with the gulls, I see.
It's the {festival}. Half the town's drunk and the other half's working on it.

options.label: I want some new ink. (5 doubloons)

text: On a whaler, off the cold coast. Long nights, a needle and a lot of very bored sailors.
The scars I do for free. Well, the sea does them for free. I just tidy them up.
